Drift is a living wallpaper for Mac. It paints slow, moving gradients on your desktop that shift with the time of day and your local weather: warm light at sunset, rain, snow and storms when they arrive. Start with one of our nine beautiful palettes or generate your own. Turn on Real Sky to match the light and weather conditions outside your window. It runs as your real wallpaper on every display, and as your screen saver too. Free for 14 days. Launch price $12/year until December 18, then $15.

Title: Solace: Your Mac, in tune with the world around you
# Your Mac, in tune with the world around you. Solace is a Mac menu bar app that adapts your screen's appearance, warmth, and wallpaper, so your Mac always feels right. It lives in your menu bar. And it keeps your screen in harmony with the world outside. ## One wallpaper for the day. Your light mode wallpaper greets you each morning. ## Another one for the night. The switch happens the moment the sky says so. Light mode arrives with the morning. Dark mode follows the dusk. Solace calculates exact solar times for your location, every day, every season. At the time you choose, your display gently warms. Start it at sunset, at a time you choose, or keep it on all day. Solace reads the forecast each morning and sets the day, so your screen never flickers back and forth. 14 days for your refund. ## What happens on your Mac stays on your Mac. One menu bar app that keeps your Mac in sync with the day. It switches light and dark automatically, warms the screen at night, swaps your wallpaper to match, and can turn dark on grey, overcast days. Solace follows your local sunrise and sunset, and you can move either one up to 2 hours earlier or later. How to schedule dark mode on Mac. Yes. Evening Warmth eases your screen from cool daylight (6500K) to warm candlelight (1900K), from sunset, from a time you choose, or all the time. While it is on, Solace takes over from Night Shift and hands it back afterwards, with a Compatibility Mode for the newest Macs. Yes. Set a light wallpaper and a dark one, and Solace swaps them across all your displays the moment the mode changes. Your location is used only to find sunrise and sunset and, if you enable weather, to check Apple's WeatherKit. None of your data is ever sent to us. Every feature is free to try for 14 days. After that it is a one-time $9.99: no subscription, no in-app purchases, and free updates. Yes. Download Solace and every feature is free for 14 days, with no card needed.
